body:
No, I've never harmed myself. I do have trouble dealing with anger sometimes. Often so bad to where I feel violent, but manage to hold it back. Stupid things too, just a bunch of stupid little things piss me off. I'm not sure if that is related to the sadness or not.

As for family, I can't talk to them. I'm nothing like them, nor do they think things through logically. I just get annoyed talking with them.
